Name: Red's Penny
Author: magimatica
Description:
Just some tweaks to suit my own preference. Changed hair, added freckles, added some rufflies to her swimsuit (as suggested by the description of it given in the locker room), redid crying portrait entirely.

Edit 4/28/24: My bad, I'd grabbed a wrong file, corrected!

Edit 4/25/24: Updated for v1.6, with new portraits & winter clothes, both CP and XNB versions. Shoutout to Jaime for the ko-fi!

Edit 1/31/21: Updated for v1.5, with the new front-on portrait and beach portraits; the new version is packaged for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]!

Edit 2/19/21: Added an xnb version of the updated files as an optional file.
